verdicts.reason: A is a plain crop that shrinks the title block: 'Spa Utopia' is tiny and lost in the middle of the banner, and the 'Weekly SPA items review' tagline is too small to read. It keeps the original's quiet composition and the brush stroke behind the title. B makes the title huge and puts it on one line, but it runs straight over the green bottle, dropper and glass jar. The tagline is too big, wraps to two lines and sits on the busy leaves. The brush stroke now floats on its own with no text on it, so B has more collisions and loses more of the original's look.
